Test build on upstream main (newer than v0.3.3). Installs next to the regular Rakazo app.

Extra features on top of upstream:
- Receive shares from other Android apps (upstream PR #1563)
- Localised notifications and permission follow-up (upstream PR #1806)
- Voice calls kept alive by a foreground service (upstream PR #1807)
- Live working status on by default
- Keep unchanged messages when a polled snapshot arrives
- No pause between spoken sentences

Already in upstream: split view, double tap to react, drop files, scroll to a just-sent message.

Built 2026-10-24.
